title: 第八百八十二章 余韵第八百八十一章 事后
lines: “楚宽，把父皇送的那块新墨拿来。”
当这句话久久没有引来回音之后，三皇子这才抬起头来，随即深深叹了一口气。每天在慈庆宫里读书，时间越是长，越是能感受到楚宽的妥帖和好处。人常常只是默默站在这里，就能把你的所有需要全部满足，所以但凡是像现在这样人突然不在，他反而就不习惯了。
“果然是由俭入奢易，由奢入俭难。”小小的太子殿下迸出了这么一句并不怎么适合此情此景的话，继而就忍不住思量，楚宽这又是上哪去了。前一次人出远门，他还记得，那是去营救被那群叛贼挟持为人质的二皇子，虽说后来没能救成，却也杀光所有叛贼做了陪祭。
而楚宽名为万安宫管事牌子，可母亲从来都没要求楚宽呆在万安宫，反而殷切嘱咐楚宽好好照应他，如今人不在慈庆宫，却也绝对不在万安宫，必定是又出宫办什么事去了。
说起来，自从那次二皇子的事情之后，父皇对人看似疏远了许多，他是不是要劝一劝？
当三皇子在心里盘算着这件事时，他突然听到外间传来了一阵喧哗，然后随着一声三哥，四皇子就一阵风似的冲了进来。可是，人前脚刚进门，却又拨开门帘对外头大声嚷嚷道：“我和三哥说话，你们全都给我滚远远的，不许靠近！”
三皇子顿时心里一阵纳闷。今天的课已经都结束了，侍读们也都回去了。鉴于之前某些老大人们希望不要在这里用识文断字的内侍，而楚宽又常常在这里执役，这慈庆宫也就是外头有一些洒扫的人，绝对不敢进来又或者偷听，他这四弟的吩咐不是多此一举吗？
四皇子当然不知道自家三哥竟然想的是这个。他一溜烟冲上前来，一把拉起三皇子，东张西望了一会儿，就立刻压低声音说：“三哥，楚宽死了！”
“什么死了？”三皇子第一时间还没反应过来，问了一句之后，他这才终于醒悟到四皇子到底说了什么，脸色遽变，“他怎么可能死的！是谁行刺他，还是……”
还是两个字之后的话，到了嘴边之后，三皇子却硬生生给掐断了。如果不是行刺，那么能杀死楚宽的人，就只可能是父皇。可父皇为什么要这样做？楚宽不是从小和父皇一块长大的人吗？据说，在那个最危险的时期，人曾经救过父皇和太后好几次！
四皇子见三皇子面色变幻不定，低头再看见人拳头捏紧了又松开，松开了又握紧，分明是情绪激动，虽说他不怎么明白三哥什么时候和楚宽关系这么好了，但他还是聪明地没有追问下去，而是小声说道：“是陈永寿特地告诉我的，还吩咐让我告诉三哥，今后别再提他。”
在三皇子看来，这就等同于确证父皇因为什么事杀了楚宽。他原本苍白的脸一下子变得更白了一些，待要说些什么，可嘴唇哆嗦了好一阵子，他却愣是一个字都没能说出来。足足好一会儿，他才恢复了语言能力。
“四弟，你让我想一想……”
四皇子看出三皇子此时一颗心已经乱了，他犹豫了一下，最后就小声问道：“这事儿挺突然的，而且陈公公既然这么提醒，背后肯定有名堂……要不，我去请教一下老师？他是父皇很信任的人，而且消息也灵通。这会儿太阳还没落山，我抓紧的话应该来得及跑一趟。”
虽然理智告诉自己，不应该因为这种事去打扰张寿，而且三皇子扪心自问，自己毕竟还没到离不开楚宽的地步，更谈不上多深厚的情分，毕竟，他又不是父皇那样，和人从小一块长大，几十年的朝夕相处。
因此，斟酌了好一会儿，他最终小声说道：“四弟你去见老师的时候，话说得缓和一些，就说楚宽如果死了，父皇会不会因此情绪低落，我这个身为儿子的又该如何。其他的话你不要多问，陈公公既然单独提醒你，这事情最好还是谨慎一些。”
“三哥你就看我的吧！”
四皇子信心满满，却是也顾不得安抚三皇子的情绪了，转身拔腿就跑。他这一走，刚刚勉强维持住太子兄长样子的三皇子，这才完全没有继续假装的力气了，脑海中满满当当都是说不清道不明的恐惧。这恐惧不是因为楚宽的死，而是他想到这两年父皇身边已经没了的人。
废后母子三人，再加上楚宽，也许还得算上柳枫这个曾经的管事牌子……这都算得上是父皇曾经最亲近的人了。虽然后两个和前三个的地位天差地别，但在亲近程度上却差不了多少，在历经这样一次次的严重打击之后，父皇心里是个什么滋味？
三皇子竭力不去想自己的事，想楚宽的事，而是设身处地试图去站在父皇的立场上思量这一桩桩一件件，一个人枯坐在那里，不知不觉就有些痴了。而外间人没有吩咐却也不敢进来，他也不知道就这么坐了多久，甚至忘了嘴中口渴，腹中饥饿。
直到那个熟悉的声音去而复返，他才一下子惊醒了过来。抬头看到叫嚷着三哥的四皇子风风火火进来，背后却没有跟着张寿，他虽说因为四周环境而意识到夜晚降临，宫门将闭，老师没可能在这种时候入宫，但心里却还到底有些失落和遗憾。
但下一刻，这些情绪就被四皇子挨着他坐下的那番耳语给完全冲散了：“三哥，幸好我去问老师，原来楚宽今天是在白云观约见老师，后来就自尽的！”
感觉到一旁的兄长已经完全僵在了那儿，想到自己之前在张寿那儿听到事情原委时也是这样发懵到几乎失语的情景，四皇子就觉得这完全在情理之中。
虽说张寿没有对他说得太详细，但他还是绘声绘色地把张寿告诉他的故事再次加工了一番，然后转述给了三皇子。哪怕没有朱泾和楚宽一来一往多番言语交锋的细节，可具体事由却很清楚了。
可是，当他说得告一段落，深深吸了一口气打算骂人两句时，就听到了一个幽幽的声音：“这种事居然舍近求远去问张寿，你怎么不知道来亲自问朕？”
兄弟俩同时抬头，当发现来的是自家父皇，四皇子几乎下意识地直接闪到了三皇子背后。见父皇脸色有些青白，眼睛里甚至有些血丝，熊孩子也不知道是哪来的冲动，竟是鼓起勇气叫道：“父皇你别伤心，为楚宽那种家伙，不值得……”
可他这话还没说完，就发现自家父皇那表情异常吓人，这顿时直接就给镇住了。他有些畏怯地缩了缩脑袋，有心表现得一下自己的勇气，可到头来还是闭上了嘴。结果，皇帝下一刻说出来的话，就把他再次吓着了。于是，熊孩子一千个一万个庆幸自己没继续说下去。
“为他伤心确实不值得。你们的那两个不成器的兄长，都是他杀的，废后也是他杀的，朕现在想想，这母子三人固然做过很多蠢事错事，死了也确实不冤枉，但有些事情，只怕是楚宽栽赃在他们头上的。朕之所以废后逐子，其实有很大一部分都是他促成的。”
三皇子只觉得后背心发凉，想要劝慰，舌头却犹如僵住了似的一个字都说不出来。因为他已然意识到，父皇废后逐子，这其中最大的受益者就是自己，而自己又因为楚宽的死而陷入彷徨，一旦父皇疑心他又或者母亲，那就真的是天大的祸事了。
小小的太子陷入了前所未有的惊怖之中，直到后背传来了四皇子不停戳戳戳的温软触感，他这才惊醒了过来，可说话的声音却已然有些沙哑：“父皇，这些是老师说的吗？”
“你老师没那么饶舌，他在鬼门关上转了一圈，却几乎什么都没说，话都是他岳父，也就是赵国公说的。当然，赵国公又不是无事不知的阎罗王，这些是楚宽亲口告诉他的。朕想了想，大概是楚宽这次早就做了最坏的打算，要么同归于尽，要么他事败身死。”
“按照他的性格，如果死了，一定不愿意让朕还念着他昔日的好处，所以会把话说清楚，让朕对他恨之入骨才好。”
说到这里，皇帝哂然一笑，随即突然伸出手指，在三皇子背后那呆若木鸡四皇子的额头上猛地一弹，见熊孩子赶紧捂住了额头，他就淡淡地说，“陈永寿怕你们兄弟俩在朕这儿触霉头，所以特意提醒你，你倒好……”
“竟然还特意出宫去找张寿求教？他听到楚宽两个字没对你翻脸，没把你赶出去，就已经算是很有气度了！”
见四皇子噤若寒蝉，三皇子欲言又止，站直身子的皇帝这才淡淡地说：“这段日子，朕伤心难过的次数太多，多到已经快麻木了，这次也不例外。尤其是之前困扰朕很久的某些疑惑也算是有了答案，所以其实也没什么可难过的。”
皇帝虽然如此说，但三皇子却敏锐地看到，自家父皇嘴角下垂，拳头还紧紧握着，分明心情绝不平静。哪怕他并不知道其中很多细节，可是，单单四皇子和皇帝所说的这些，就已经足够让他震动了。于是，刚刚生出的那一点惊悸，顿时变成了另一种冲动。
小小的东宫太子下意识地伸出手去，直接抱住了面前的父皇。然而，他却一个字都没说，只是死死抱着，仿佛要用尽自己的全身力气。
而这种抱大腿哭就完了的招数，张寿确实传授过，但刚刚四皇子风风火火进来后对三皇子说的话，皇帝自忖都听得清清楚楚，绝对没有再教这一招。这也从此刻四皇子那目瞪口呆的样子也能看得出来。
因此，在最初的微微一愣过后，皇帝忍不住就笑了起来。虽说那笑声中满是苦涩，但紧绷的情绪却渐渐放开，直到他听见了一声嚷嚷。
“三哥你好狡猾，也不叫我一声！”四皇子不管三七二十一，直接也扑了上去抱住了皇帝的一条大腿，随即也同样不开口说话，就这么紧紧抱着不放。
眼见小的依样画葫芦学大的，而之前去看五皇子时，那个什么事都不明白的小婴儿，却还冲着他张牙舞爪，最后却咯咯笑了起来，皇帝怔忡良久，最终终究是一手一个，轻轻揉了揉他们的脑袋。
三皇子已然加冠，四皇子却不愿意这么早，所以兄弟俩的装束差别很明显。一个金冠硌手，一个则是依旧总角打扮。所以，只凭这手感，皇帝揉了揉之后，就忍不住笑了。
同样是从小一块长大，二皇子就一心想着和大皇子争，从衣服饮食的精美程度，别院大小，随从多寡，赏赐多少，再到东宫的位子。而三皇子和四皇子却好得抵足而眠，同进同出，甚至小的会为了大的入主东宫而高兴，会为了大的而去故意犯错显拙……
楚宽也许确实做错了很多很多事情，然而，至少有一件事，人却并没有做错，那就是让他痛定思痛，选了当时并不算特别合适的三皇子为太子。
想到这里，皇帝终于摇了摇头，试图把这些遐思都从脑海中驱赶出去，随即就松开手说：“好了好了，这么大的人了，还撒娇……时候不早了，跟朕去一趟清宁宫，陪着太后好好吃一顿晚饭。”
content_en:
"Chu Kuan, bring the new piece of ink given by your father."
When there was no response to this sentence for a long time, the third prince raised his head and sighed deeply. The longer I study in Ciqing Palace every day, the more I feel the appropriateness and benefits of Chu Kuan. People can often satisfy all your needs just by standing here silently, so whenever someone is suddenly absent like now, he is not used to it.
"Sure enough, it is easy to go from frugality to luxury, but it is difficult to go from luxury to frugality." The little prince said something that was not very suitable for this situation, and then he couldn't help but think about where Chu Kuan was. He still remembered the last time he went on a far journey to rescue the second prince who was held hostage by a group of rebels. Although he failed to rescue him, he still killed all the rebels as sacrifices.
Chu Kuan was called the steward of Wan'an Palace, but his mother never asked Chu Kuan to stay in Wan'an Palace. Instead, she earnestly asked Chu Kuan to take good care of him. Now that he was not in Ciqing Palace, he was definitely not in Wan'an Palace. He must have gone out of the palace to do something else.
Speaking of which, since the incident with the second prince, my father seemed to have become much more distant from others. Did he want to give him some advice?
When the third prince was thinking about this in his mind, he suddenly heard a commotion outside, and then with the sound of "third brother", the fourth prince rushed in like a gust of wind. However, as soon as he entered the door, he opened the door curtain and shouted loudly outside: "I'm talking to the third brother, all of you, stay away from me and don't come near!"
The third prince suddenly felt puzzled. Today's classes are over and all the students have gone back. In view of the fact that some elders previously hoped not to use literate chamberlains here, and Chu Kuan often served here, there were some sweepers outside the Ciqing Palace who would never dare to come in or eavesdrop. Aren't his fourth brother's orders unnecessary?
Of course the fourth prince didn't know that his third brother was thinking about this. He rushed forward in a flash, grabbed the third prince, looked around for a while, and then immediately lowered his voice and said: "Third brother, Chu Kuan is dead!"
"What's dead?" The third prince didn't react immediately. After asking, he finally realized what the fourth prince had said, and his expression suddenly changed, "How could he be dead! Who assassinated him, or..."
After the words came to his mouth after two words, the third prince cut them off abruptly. If it wasn't an assassination, then the only person who could kill Chu Kuan could be his father. But why would my father do this? Didn't Chu Kuan grow up with his father? It is said that during the most dangerous period, I saved my father and the Queen Mother several times!
The fourth prince saw that the third prince's expression was changing. He lowered his head and saw that the man's fists were clenching and unclenching, and then clenching again. He was obviously excited. Although he didn't quite understand when the third brother and Chu Kuan had such a good relationship, he still wisely did not ask further. Instead, he whispered: "Chen Yongshou specifically told me, and he also ordered me to tell the third brother not to mention him again in the future."
In the eyes of the third prince, this was equivalent to confirming why his father killed Chu Kuan. His originally pale face suddenly turned paler. He was about to say something, but his lips were trembling for a while, but he was unable to say a word. It took a long time before he regained his ability to speak.
"Fourth brother, let me think about it..."
The fourth prince saw that the third prince's heart was in chaos at this time. He hesitated for a moment, and finally asked in a low voice: "This matter is quite sudden, and since Eunuch Chen reminds me so, there must be something famous behind it... How about I go ask the teacher for advice? He is a person whom my father trusts very much, and he is well-informed. The sun has not set yet, if I hurry up, I should have time to make a trip."
Although his reason told him that he should not disturb Zhang Shou for this kind of thing, and the third prince asked himself, after all, he was not inseparable from Chu Kuan, let alone a deep friendship. After all, he was not like his father, who grew up with him and got along with him day and night for decades.
Therefore, after thinking for a while, he finally whispered: "Fourth brother, when you go to see the teacher, you should speak more calmly and ask if Chu Kuan dies, will my father be depressed because of this, and what will happen to me as a son? Otherwise, don't ask more. Since Eunuch Chen has reminded you alone, it is best to be more cautious about this matter."
"Third brother, just look at me!"
The fourth prince was full of confidence, but he couldn't care less about appeasing the third prince's mood, so he turned around and ran away. As soon as he left, the third prince, who had just managed to maintain his appearance as the prince's brother, no longer had the strength to continue pretending, and his mind was filled with indescribable fear. This fear was not because of Chu Kuan's death, but because he thought about the people who had disappeared from his father's side in the past two years.
The three people including the deposed mother and son, plus Chu Kuan, and maybe Liu Feng, the former steward... these can be regarded as the closest people to the father. Although the status of the last two and the first three are very different, the degree of closeness is not much different. After experiencing such severe blows, how does the father feel in his heart?
The third prince tried his best not to think about his own affairs or Chu Kuan's affairs. Instead, he tried to put himself in his father's position and think about everything one by one. Sitting there alone, he became a little crazy without knowing it. Outsiders did not dare to come in without being ordered. He did not know how long he sat like this, and he even forgot that he was thirsty in his mouth and hungry in his belly.
It wasn't until that familiar voice came back that he suddenly woke up. He looked up and saw the fourth prince shouting for his third brother coming in, but Zhang Shou was not following him. Although he realized that night was coming and the palace gate would be closed because of the surrounding environment, and it was impossible for the teacher to enter the palace at this time, he still felt a little disappointed and regretful in his heart.
But the next moment, these emotions were completely dissipated by the whisper of the fourth prince sitting next to him: "Third brother, luckily I asked the teacher. It turned out that Chu Kuan had an appointment with the teacher at Baiyun Temple today, and then committed suicide!"
Feeling that his brother beside him was completely frozen, and thinking that he had been so confused and almost speechless when he heard the whole story from Zhang Shou, the fourth prince felt that this was completely reasonable.
Although Zhang Shou did not tell him in too much detail, he still reprocessed the story Zhang Shou told him vividly and then relayed it to the third prince. Even though there are no details of the many verbal exchanges between Zhu Jing and Chu Kuan, the specific reasons are very clear.
However, when he came to an end and took a deep breath to curse someone, he heard a faint voice: "You would go far away to ask Zhang Shou about something like this. Why don't you know to ask me in person?"
The two brothers looked up at the same time. When they realized that it was their father who was coming, the fourth prince almost subconsciously ducked behind the third prince. Seeing that his father's face was a little pale and his eyes were even bloodshot, the naughty boy didn't know where the impulse came from, but he mustered up the courage to shout: "Father, don't be sad, for a guy like Chu Kuan, it's not worth it..."
But before he could finish his words, he noticed that his father's expression was extremely scary, and he was immediately restrained. He shrank his head timidly, intending to show off his courage, but in the end he kept his mouth shut. As a result, what the emperor said next moment frightened him again. So, the naughty kid was thankful that he didn't continue talking.
"It's really not worth being sad for him. Your two useless brothers were both killed by him, and he killed the empress when she was deposed. Now that I think about it, although the mother and son did many stupid things and wrong things, and their deaths are indeed not unjust, but there are some things that Chu Kuan may have framed them. The reason why I deposed the empress and chased the son, is actually a large part of his contribution."
The third prince felt a chill on his back and wanted to comfort him, but his tongue seemed to be frozen and he couldn't say a word. Because he has realized that the biggest beneficiary of his father's dethronement of the queen and his son is himself, and he is in a state of confusion because of Chu Kuan's death. Once his father suspects him or his mother, it will really be a big disaster.
The little prince fell into unprecedented fear. It was not until he felt the soft touch of the fourth prince's constant poking on his back that he woke up, but his voice was already a little hoarse: "Father, is this what the teacher said?"
"Your teacher is not that talkative. He walked around the gate of hell but said almost nothing. The words were all said by his father-in-law, Duke Zhao. Of course, Duke Zhao is not the King of Hell who knows everything. Chu Kuan told him these things personally. After thinking about it, Chu Kuan probably made the worst plan this time. Either we will die together or he will be ruined and die."
"According to his character, if he dies, he will definitely not want me to still remember his past benefits, so he will speak clearly and let me hate him to the core."
Having said this, the emperor smiled suddenly, then suddenly stretched out his finger and flicked the fourth prince, who was stunned behind the third prince, on the forehead. Seeing that the naughty boy quickly covered his forehead, he said lightly, "Chen Yongshou is afraid that you two brothers will get into trouble with me, so I specially remind you that you are better..."
"You actually went out of the palace to ask Zhang Shou for advice? He didn't turn his back on you or kick you out when he heard the word "Chu Kuan". That's considered very generous!"
Seeing that the fourth prince was silent and the third prince hesitated to speak, the emperor who stood up straight said calmly: "I have been sad and sad so many times in these days that I am almost numb, and this time is no exception. Especially since some of the doubts that have troubled me for a long time have been answered, so there is actually nothing to be sad about."
Although the emperor said so, the third prince saw keenly that the corners of his father's mouth were drooping and his fists were clenched tightly, clearly showing that he was not in a calm mood. Even if he didn't know many of the details, what the fourth prince and the emperor said alone was enough to shock him. So, the little panic that just occurred suddenly turned into another impulse.
The little Prince of the East Palace subconsciously reached out and hugged his father in front of him. However, he didn't say a word, he just held on tightly, as if he was trying to use all his strength.
Zhang Shou had indeed taught this trick of hugging one's thighs and then crying, but what the fourth prince Feng Feng Huohuo said to the third prince just after he came in was clearly heard by the emperor and he would never teach him this trick again. This can also be seen from the stunned look on the fourth prince's face at this moment.
Therefore, after the initial slight surprise, the emperor couldn't help but laugh. Although the laughter was full of bitterness, the tense emotions gradually relaxed until he heard a yell.
"Third brother, you are so cunning, and you didn't even call me!" The fourth prince didn't care, he rushed forward and hugged one of the emperor's thighs, and then he also didn't say a word, just hugging him tightly.
Seeing that the little one was imitating the big one, but when he went to see the fifth prince, the little baby who didn't understand anything still bared his teeth and claws at him, and finally started to giggle. The emperor was stunned for a long time, and finally he used his hands one by one and gently rubbed their heads.
The third prince has already been crowned, but the fourth prince is unwilling to do so so early, so the difference in the attire of the two brothers is obvious. One has a gold crown on his hand, and the other is still dressed as a horn. Therefore, just based on this feeling, the emperor couldn't help but smile after rubbing it.
Having grown up together, the second prince was obsessed with competing with the eldest prince, from the exquisiteness of his clothes and food, the size of his court, the number of his followers, the amount of rewards, and even the seat in the East Palace. However, the third prince and the fourth prince were so happy that they could sleep together, going in and out together. The younger one would even be happy that the older one would take over the East Palace, and would deliberately make mistakes and show his clumsiness for the older one...
Chu Kuan may indeed have done many things wrong, but there was at least one thing he did not do wrong, which was to let him learn from the experience and choose the third prince, who was not particularly suitable at the time, as the crown prince.
Thinking of this, the emperor finally shook his head, trying to expel these reveries from his mind, and then let go of his hand and said: "Okay, okay, you are such a big man, and you are still acting like a baby... It's getting late, come with me to Qingning Palace, and have a good dinner with the Queen Mother."
